newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Jinjiang Tower buys stakes.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Jinjiang Tower buys stakes.

text.p: Shanghai Jinjiang Tower Co Ltd said on Monday it plans to spend 38.75 million yuan to buy shares of three firms, including a shopping centre, and will sell its holding in a commercial building for 17.6 million yuan.
The plans must be approved by a shareholders meeting, the company said in statement in the Shanghai Securities News.
The company plans to buy a 10 percent share of Jinjiang Metro Shopping Centre, a Sino-German wholesaler, for 22.41 million yuan ($2.7 million) from the Jinjiang Group, it said.

Shanghai Jinjiang Tower also plans over the next three years to invest 9.34 million yuan ($1.125 million), or 7.5 percent of the total capital, in a golf club in a Shanghai suburb, of which the balance will be held by a Singapore company, it said.
The company will also put seven million yuan into a tourism village at Sheshan, a suburb of Shanghai, for a 20-percent share of the investment, it said.

Shanghai Jinjiang Tower will sell a local company 10 percent of its holding in New Jinjiang Commercial Building Co in central Shanghai for 17.6 million yuan. It then will own 40 percent of the building, with other two partners each having 30 percent, the newspaper said without elaborating.
